b001.text: Is photo ko dhyaan se dekho. Baarish ho rahi hai. Taipei ki ek gali mein ek chhota sa restaurant hai — aur sheeshe ke peeche, duniya ki sabse keemti company ka sabse keemti aadmi baitha hai.

b002.text: Uske saath ek lady hai — Alice Huang. Woh uske kandhe par haath rakhti hai, uske kaan mein kuch kehti hai. Aur dinner khatam hote hi, woh uski gaadi mein baith jaati hai.

b003.text: Dedh saal baad, America ki intelligence kahegi — yeh lady China ki bheji hui ek jasus thi. Lekin yeh film faisla nahi sunayegi.

b004.text: Yeh film har saboot ko ek hi table par rakhegi — jo record par hai, jo sirf aarop hai, jiska jawab diya gaya hai, aur jo abhi tak kisi ko nahi pata.

b005.text: Aur sabse pehli baat: Alice Huang par duniya mein kahin koi case darj nahi hai. File khuli hai.
